tourPageContent.what-do-we-see-on: What do we see on the Cape Peninsula tour?
tourPageContent.the-suggested-route-incl: The suggested route includes Muizenberg Beach, Boulders Beach and its penguin colony, Cape Point Lighthouse, the Cape of Good Hope, lunch at Dixie's in Simon's Town and the scenic Chapman's Peak drive on the way back.
tourPageContent.will-we-see-the-penguins: Will we see the penguins at Boulders Beach?
tourPageContent.boulders-beach-is-home-t: Boulders Beach is home to a colony of African penguins and is a planned stop on the tour. Your chauffeur will give you as much time there as you want.
tourPageContent.where-do-we-stop-for: Where do we stop for lunch on the Cape Peninsula tour?
tourPageContent.lunch-at-dixie-s-in: Lunch at Dixie's in Simon's Town is part of the suggested route. If you prefer somewhere else or have dietary needs, tell us when you book and we will plan around it.

tourPageContent.is-the-cape-peninsula-to: Is the Cape Peninsula tour suitable for families and children?
tourPageContent.very-much-so-the-private: Very much so. The private format means no rushing and no crowds, and your chauffeur will adapt the pace to your group. Boulders Beach and Cape Point are particular hits with younger travellers.
tourPageContent.your-cape-town-city-and: Your Cape Town City and Table Mountain Day

tourPageContent.how-long-is-the-city: How long is the city and Table Mountain tour?
tourPageContent.plan-for-about-8-hours-2: Plan for about 8 hours from hotel pickup to drop-off. Saving Table Mountain for the late afternoon means you can finish with the city lights coming on.
tourPageContent.what-if-the-weather-is: What if the weather is bad on Table Mountain?
tourPageContent.table-mountain-is-weathe: Table Mountain is weather dependent. Because the day is private, your chauffeur can reorder the stops and move the mountain to the clearest part of the day.
tourPageContent.can-we-add-the-helicopte: Can we add the helicopter flight or a harbour cruise?
tourPageContent.yes-a-scenic-helicopter-: Yes. A scenic helicopter flight and a harbour cruise from the V&A Waterfront are listed as options on the itinerary. Message us on WhatsApp and we will help you plan them into the day.

tourPageContent.very-much-so-the-private: Very much so. The private format means no rushing and the flexibility to adapt the day for younger travellers. Camps Bay and the Waterfront are easy favourites with families.

tourPageContent.how-long-is-the-wineland: How long is the Winelands tour?
tourPageContent.plan-for-about-8-hours-3: Plan for about 8 hours from hotel pickup to drop-off. If you want to linger over lunch or a tasting, just say so.

tourPageContent.yes-a-professional-chauf: Yes. A professional chauffeur drives all day, so your group can enjoy the tastings without worrying about driving.
tourPageContent.is-the-winelands-tour-go: Is the Winelands tour good for a romantic trip or anniversary?

tourPageContent.transport-game-drive-mea: Transport, game drive, meals and local guidance are all in. You focus on the experience. We handle the rest.
